Name: Azure Web App
Description: Deploys a specified package as an Azure Web App

Properties.Name: Package details
Properties.Description: Specify details of the package to be deployed

Properties.Name: Deployment slot
Properties.Description: Optional name of the slot to which the app should be deployed

Properties.Name: Azure Web App Configuration
Properties.Description: Provide app configuration values supported by native Azure App Service

Properties.Name: Application Settings
Properties.Description: Provide JSON with application settings. Note: this will replace/overwrite existing App Settings of the Azure Web App. E.g. { "Setting1": "Value1", "Setting2": "..." }

Properties.Name: Connection strings
Properties.Description: JSON with connection strings. Note: this will replace/overwrite existing Connection Strings of the Azure Web App. E.g. { "ConnString1": { "Type": "MySql", "Value": "connection-string-value" }, "ConnString2": { ... } }

Properties.Name: Transformations
Properties.Description: Custom transformations of config files (XSD, JSON merging, variable replacement)

Properties.Name: Config transforms
Properties.Description: Newline-separated list of file transformation definitions. Globbing for transform source and target files is supported. File paths are relative to package root. Every line should have this format: [json|xml]: sourcefilePath => targetfilePath. E.g.: xml:foo\**\bar.*.transform => baz\output.config

Properties.Name: Replace variables in files
Properties.Description: Newline-separated list of file path for which variable transformation should be applied. This operation is performed after Config Transform. File paths are relative to the package root. Globbing is supported e.g. folder\**\foo.*.config

Properties.Name: Replace variables in JSON files located based on hierarchical variable names
Properties.Description: Newline-separated list of JSON file paths for which nested values should be replaced with variable values based on variable names that match JSON hierarchy. This matching requires JSON nested property names to be concatenated with a colon (:). Example: to replace value of 'bar' with 234 in this JSON: { "foo": { "bar": 123 } } create a variable named 'foo:bar' and set its value to 234. This operation is performed after 'Replace variables in files'. File paths are relative to the package root. Globbing is supported e.g. folder\**\foo.*.config.
